text: Research the bet before you make it. Game logs, hit rates, matchups and a projection for any prop, spread or total. Lines load automatically from DraftKings via ESPN when they're posted. Search any player above, or pick a league. Today's NBA This week's NFL Custom calculator BASKETBALL 🏀 NBA PRO 🏀 WNBA 🏀 College Basketball 🏀 Women's College BB FOOTBALL 🏈 NFL PRO 🏈 College Football BASEBALL ⚾ MLB HOCKEY 🏒 NHL SOCCER ⚽ Premier League ⚽ La Liga ⚽ Serie A ⚽ Bundesliga ⚽ Ligue 1 ⚽ Champions League ⚽ MLS ⚽ Liga MX RACING 🏎️ Formula 1 PRO 🏁 NASCAR Cup PRO 🏁 IndyCar GOLF ⛳ PGA Tour ⛳ LPGA TENNIS 🎾 ATP Tennis 🎾 WTA Tennis COMBAT 🥊 UFC OTHER 🧮 Any sport (custom) How the projection works Starts from the player's recent average, weighted toward the latest games, blended with the longer-term average. Basketball and hockey scale by expected minutes, which you can override for injuries or blowouts. Adjusts for the opponent: points allowed, opponent misses and pace (NBA), pass/run defense (NFL). Turns the projection into an over/under probability using the player's own game-to-game variance, then blends it with the actual hit rate. Compares that to the sportsbook price to get edge and expected value. A–C grades need a real edge; anything smaller says PASS. Tips Install it like an app: on iPhone tap Share → Add to Home Screen; on Android tap ⋮ → Install app. Tap ★ Save on any analysis to track it. text: Home › NFL › Patrick Mahomes Patrick Mahomes Kansas City Chiefs · QB · #15 Next: @ DEN · Sun, Nov 1 9:25 PM · game page › Latest: Mahomes completed 19 of 33 passes for 165 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 20-3 loss to the Seahawks. He added two rushing attempts for 14 yards. Mahomes was picked off in the second quarter and remarkably recovered his own fumble in a pile of bodies to avoid a second turnover in the third quarter, setting up a Harrison Butker field goal on the next play for the Chiefs' only points of the night. This was the first start in Mahomes' career during which Kansas City failed to reach the red zone, and he hasn't thrown a touchdown pass in two games since KC's Week 5 bye. Seattle's defense dominated while Kansas City struggled to move the ball in the absence of No. 1 WR Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee), whom the Chiefs will hope to get back for a Week 8 road game against the Broncos.
